faq.q: What time does the fishing and sunset combo charter start?
faq.a: The 2039 experience typically starts at 10:00 for a 4-hour fishing session, then returns to Puerto Banús for a break. The sunset cruise departs at 18:00 and runs until 20:00. You can also book a single 2-hour fishing trip or a 2-hour sunset cruise separately.

faq.q: What is included in the price?
faq.a: The price includes a licensed skipper, fuel, fishing gear and bait, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden costs.

faq.q: Can we keep the fish we catch?
faq.a: Yes, you can keep your catch if it meets local size and species regulations. Alternatively, we practice catch and release. The skipper will advise on what’s allowed and can help clean the fish for you.

faq.q: What type of boat is used for this charter?
faq.a: The charter uses the Azimut 39, a 12.5m motor yacht with a spacious cockpit and flybridge. It accommodates up to 11 guests and is fully equipped for both fishing and cruising. All safety gear and fishing tackle are onboard.

faq.q: Do I need a fishing license?
faq.a: No, the boat’s charter license covers recreational fishing for guests. You just need to show up. The skipper will brief you on local rules and help with baiting and casting.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad?
faq.a: Your safety is paramount. If the skipper deems conditions unsafe, we’ll reschedule your charter at no extra cost or issue a full refund. We monitor forecasts closely and will contact you 24 hours before departure.

faq.q: Can we book this for a private group?
faq.a: Absolutely. The entire boat is yours for the day. You choose the itinerary, whether it’s a full 8-hour combo or two 2-hour sessions. Ideal for birthday parties, team events, or family outings.

faq.q: How do I book the 2039 experience?
faq.a: Contact us via WhatsApp or the booking form on our website. We’ll confirm availability for your preferred date, take a deposit, and send you a confirmation. Payment by bank transfer or card.

data.body_html:
Combine the thrill of deep-sea fishing with the romance of a Mediterranean sunset on the Marbella fishing and sunset combo charter 2039. Departing from Puerto Banús, this full-day experience on the Azimut 39 lets you chase catch in the morning and toast the golden hour with cava in hand. No other charter in Marbella packs this much variety into a single day.

Why choose the 2039 combo charter?

Most fishing charters end at lunchtime. Most sunset cruises start at 18:00. The 2039 experience gives you both — a 4-hour fishing session from 10:00 to 14:00, then a 2-hour sunset cruise from 18:00 to 20:00. You get the best of two worlds without paying double. The Azimut 39 is a 12.5m motor yacht with a flybridge, spacious cockpit, and plenty of shade. It’s built for both action and relaxation.

What you’ll catch off Marbella

The waters around Marbella are rich with species like amberjack, sea bass, bream, mackerel, and sometimes even bluefin tuna. The skipper knows the best spots near Cabopino, Cala del Faro, and the reefs off Estepona. All fishing gear, bait, and tackle are included. You don’t need experience — the crew will teach you. Catch and release is encouraged, but you can keep legal-sized fish for dinner.

Sunset cruising along the Costa del Sol

After a break on land, reboard at 18:00 for a leisurely cruise toward the Marbella coastline. The sunset views from the Azimut 39 are spectacular — the Sierra Blanca mountains turn pink, the sea glows orange, and the lights of Puerto Banús begin to twinkle. We serve cava, white wine, beer, and soft drinks with light snacks as you watch the day end. You’ll pass the Golden Mile, the Marbella Marina, and if time allows, head toward Cabopino.

Pricing and inclusions for the 2039 charter

This combo charter is priced at €749 for 2 hours (either fishing or sunset) or €2,299 for the full 8-hour day (4h fishing + break + 2h sunset). Every booking includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No extra charges. The boat accommodates up to 11 guests, making it perfect for small groups.

How to book your fishing and sunset combo charter Marbella 2039

Reserve your date via WhatsApp or our online booking system. We’ll confirm availability and take a deposit. Free cancellation up to 48 hours before departure. If the weather is poor, we reschedule or refund in full. Don’t wait — summer slots fill fast. Check our full fleet of boats in Marbella for other options, or book the Azimut 39 directly for this unique 2039 experience.
